Install openai-codex on Omarchy

OpenAI's coding agent that runs in your terminal

The official repository lists this package in Utilities. It was added on 2025-10-26.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add openai-codex
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 0.171.0-1:
    pacman -Qi openai-codex

Open and use openai-codex

To see what the package installed, including any commands and desktop entries:

pacman -Ql openai-codex

Frequently asked questions

How do I install openai-codex on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add openai-codex. The download is 187.3 MB and it takes 522.3 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is openai-codex free?

Check the project site for current pricing. The package is licensed Apache-2.0.

How do I uninstall openai-codex?

Run omarchy pkg drop openai-codex. It removes the package from your system.

What does openai-codex depend on?

The package declares 1 dependency: glibc. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is openai-codex in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as openai-codex (version 0.171.0-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. OpenAI makes it. Project site: https://github.com/openai/codex.
